descriptions.notStarted: Manji's apprentice, Mu Young, has a pensive look on his face. Shall we hear what he has to say?
descriptions.inProgress: Mu Young says his master was right to worry. He says, Balrog, who was sealed by Tristan a number of decades ago, is preparing to reemerge. He has asked you to form a Expeditionary Team to prevent Balrog from reviving.
descriptions.completed: Mu Young says his master was right to worry. He says, Balrog, who was sealed by Tristan a number of decades ago, is preparing to reemerge. He has asked you to form a Expeditionary Team to prevent Balrog from reviving.\r\nBut as you tried to prevent Balrog's revival, he disappeared into thin air, and you had to tell Mu Young.
